name: playyy
description: Create editable designs, slide decks, presentations, and websites in Playyy from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Playyy turns a brief into editable work you can keep refining. Ask for a slide deck or presentation, a poster, flyer, or social graphic, or a one-page website, and Playyy builds it as real pages in its editor — not flat images. Keep iterating in conversation: rewrite copy, change colours, or rework a single slide or section.

Use your own logo or photos as reference, find files by title, export designs to PNG, JPG, or PPTX, and turn workspace link sharing on or off for a file. Playyy also creates and edits documents and exports sheets to XLSX. Playyy only accesses the workspace you authorize when you sign in.
defaultPrompt: Make a 6-slide pitch deck for a coffee subscription startup.
Build a one-page website for our design studio with services and a contact section.
Design an A4 poster for our summer rooftop party on 12 July.

positive.description: Create a slide deck from a brief
positive.prompt: Use Playyy to make a 6-slide pitch deck for Brightloop, a startup that rents refurbished e-bikes to delivery riders. Cover the problem, solution, market, business model, team, and the ask, with a green accent colour.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a design task, polls it until it completes, and replies with a preview of the first slide and a link that opens the editable deck in the Playyy editor.

positive.description: Refine an existing design and export it
positive.prompt: In my Playyy Brightloop deck, make the market slide lead with a 40% month-over-month growth figure, then export the whole deck as PowerPoint.
positive.expected_behavior: Edits the same design, waits for the task to complete, then exports the deck as PPTX and returns the download link.

positive.description: Design with the user's own logo
positive.prompt: Here's our logo: https://playyy.ai/marketing-assets/images/brand/figma-hero/playyy-logo.png. Use Playyy to create an editable A4 poster for our summer rooftop party on 12 July with the logo at the top.
positive.expected_behavior: Stages the logo as an attachment, starts a poster design that uses it, polls the task until it completes, and replies with a preview and a link to the editable poster.

positive.prompt: Use Playyy to build a one-page website for Brightloop with a hero section, how it works, pricing, and a contact form.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a design task, polls it until it completes, and replies with a link that opens the editable website in the Playyy editor.

positive.description: Find a design and export a slide as an image
positive.prompt: Find my Brightloop deck in Playyy and export the first slide as a PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the deck by title and returns a download link for its first slide as a PNG image.

negative.description: Account management is out of scope
Purchases and plan upgrades are out of scope
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Playyy plan and buy more credits.
What's the weather in Singapore tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create and refine editable designs, slide decks, presentations, and websites; use your own images as reference; find and export files; manage file link sharing; create and edit documents; and export sheets to XLSX.
